major_cooldowns.name: Trueshot
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Activate right before an Aimed Shot naturally comes up and ideally just after a Rapid Fire so you carry a fresh Bulletstorm into the window; never cast it back-to-back with Volley or you waste Double Tap.

major_cooldowns.name: Volley
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press on cooldown to activate Double Tap, but never directly before or after Trueshot since that wastes the Double Tap charge from either ability.

rules.action: Begin casting your first Aimed Shot about 2.5 seconds before combat starts so it lands the instant the fight begins, and pre-cast Algeth'ar Puzzle Box around 4.5 seconds out to line the buff up with Trueshot.
Confirm Hunter's Mark is active on the highest-health target, from you or another Hunter, before the pull so your damage amplification is up from the first shot.

rules.description: Never cast Volley adjacent to Trueshot
rules.action: Always fire an Aimed Shot between Trueshot and Volley; casting them back-to-back in either order wastes the Double Tap charge that one of them generates and is a large damage loss.
Cast Rapid Fire right before activating Trueshot so you enter the window with a fresh, full-duration Bulletstorm buffing every Aimed Shot inside it.
Follow every Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire with your Precise Shots spender (Black Arrow or Arcane Shot on single target, Multi-Shot on 2+ targets); never let a Precise Shots stack go unused.

rules.description: Do not let Aimed Shot reach 2 charges
rules.action: Cast Aimed Shot when it is about to reach 2 charges so its cooldown keeps ticking; sitting at full charges wastes recharge time, while leaving it at 1 charge is fine.
Never stand idle: when nothing else is available cast Steady Shot to generate Focus and reduce Aimed Shot's cooldown, since accumulated empty globals are the biggest single DPS leak for the spec.

rules.description: Multi-Shot replaces Arcane Shot at 2+ targets
rules.action: On 2 or more targets with Trick Shots talented, spend Precise Shots with Multi-Shot instead of Arcane Shot, and never cast Aimed Shot or Rapid Fire while the Trick Shots buff is down.

rules.description: Reserve movement for non-Aimed Shot globals
rules.action: Save your repositioning for moments when you are not casting Aimed Shot; you can move freely during Steady Shot, instants, and proc spenders without losing a single cast.
